scope: Read all 88 complete authored title/setup records, 264 choice labels/result titles/result bodies/first-person journals and every declared stat/bond effect, plus relevant static eligibility/binding and capped-effect source. No source modifications, game/runtime execution, natural-encounter coverage, native/visual acceptance, external-human review, or release-build certification.
categoryPolicy: Exactly one primary category per template based on its actual text/context. Professional Creator/YouTuber/Streamer preparation stays employment-special-careers; owner complaint/contact scenes are businesses. Per-path eligibility is a separate coverage axis, not a second primary count. An extremely rare standalone absurd encounter belongs to rare-cross-life-callbacks without claiming a cross-life callback.
reviewLimits: Stat and bond changes were compared with text and static clamping/display code, not executed against boundary-state worlds. No exact numeric gain is promised in these narrative results; runtime effect rows use the effective capped difference.

Anonymous incidental speakers, props and small recollections are authored scene details; named pets, colleagues, friends, destinations, hobbies and diagnosed conditions use the existing saved context shown in source. No assertion of a natural encountered instance was made.

This assigned slice is thematically concentrated. Zero primary rows in other planned categories is reported as zero, not reclassified to satisfy target counts. Whole-catalogue target reconciliation belongs to the combined ledger.
